capability: Decide whether a proposed spend fits its budget: a bounded-autonomy cost governor that returns a within/breach verdict for any additive cost unit (dollars, tokens, API calls, compute-seconds).

Find prohibited vocabulary in any text against a compiled term policy, reporting each offending line:column with a fix - a pure, reusable prose-governance gate (a sibling of a CI-YAML linter, for words not structure).

Classify what changed at a watched source (URL, config, dependency, doc, API) against its last snapshot - first_capture/unchanged/content_changed/broken_link - via an injected fetch seam, returning the new snapshot without persisting it (a source drift detector).

Retry a flaky operation with exponential backoff, for either boundary shape: retry-on-exception (re-raise the final failure) or retry-on-result (return the last result, never raise). One validated policy (attempt budget + backoff) drives both runners.

Fail fast when a dependency is sustainedly broken: a three-state (closed/open/half-open) circuit breaker that trips after consecutive failures, fast-fails while open, then probes once after a reset timeout. Usable as a raw state machine or via a call(fn) runner.

Declare what a process needs from its environment, then load it once into an immutable, type-coerced, validated view. A field marked secret is always redacted; a default requires the explicit dev_default_ok opt-out. Every problem in the environment is reported together, naming the environment variable.
Durably record an opaque operation key exactly once. An atomic claim returns true only to the caller that creates the record, and false to every later caller using the same key.
Compose small tiles into reusable 16x16 and 32x32 metatiles, so maps store repeated visual structure once while collision and decoration remain aligned.
Pack tile index, palette selection, priority, and horizontal or vertical flip into one fixed-width map word, making tilemap storage compact and decoding deterministic.
Resolve visible pixels from ordered tile layers by priority, transparency, and occlusion, keeping background, foreground, and effect composition deterministic.
Choose LZSS, run-length encoding, or dictionary compression as part of data modeling, balancing decode cost, repetition, and storage budget instead of treating compression as a final opaque step.
Stream connected map regions through a bounded RAM window, loading the next region before traversal requires it and evicting safe regions without breaking connections.
Treat fifteen visible colours plus transparent as a hard palette budget, assigning roles deliberately so art variation fits the target display and transparency remains unambiguous.
Manage sprite and OAM residency under fixed per-frame and VRAM budgets, prioritizing visible or gameplay-critical actors when demand exceeds capacity.
Validate a save slot with a checksum and treat any mismatch as an empty slot, ensuring corruption never presents as a playable character and the failure policy is deterministic.
Store repeated dialogue phrases as dictionary tokens and expand them during rendering, trading a compact data stream for a controlled decode path and editable phrase vocabulary.
Assign data and code to explicit banks and memory regions, framing payloads so consumers can locate, load, and address them without hidden locality assumptions.
Give each frame a fixed execution budget and schedule work so rendering, input, streaming, and simulation meet that budget instead of allowing one subsystem to monopolize a frame.
Attach a small positional offset to each tile so one map representation can express effects such as shake, parallax, or irregular placement without rewriting the tile geometry.
Use a self-imposed resource or complexity budget as a design forcing function, making tradeoffs explicit before implementation and preserving room for future content.
